title: BP Energy Outlook 2030
scenario_note: Alternative cases: High GDP Case, Low GDP Case, Policy Case. The IEA 450 Scenario is shown for comparison only.

entries.subject: oil
entries.metric: global liquids demand (oil, biofuels and other liquids)
entries.quote: Global liquids demand (oil, biofuels, and other liquids) nonetheless is likely to rise by 16.5 Mb/d, exceeding 102 Mb/d by 2030.

entries.subject: renewables
entries.quote: We assume that policy supports the continued rapid growth of non- fossil power generation – especially renewables, which attain a global share of 10% by 2030.
entries.note: Share of power generation, not primary energy. No primary-energy share for renewables is stated in text; the chart shows renewables (incl. biofuels) near 7% in 2030 ('major non-fossil fuel groups on market shares of around 7% each').

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: Rail, electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids, and the use of compressed natural gas in transport is likely to grow, but without making a material contribution to total transport before 2030.

notes: First edition. No summary tables found. Renewables share of primary energy not stated in text. No EV count.
